title: PrismRoll 3D
desc: PrismRoll 3D is a challenging puzzle game where you swipe to roll a 3D block across different tiles to reach the target hole. Navigate through fragile tiles, switches, teleporters, and split mechanics across 100 unique levels. Customize your block with different skins and shapes. Can you beat them all?.
howto: Swipe or use Arrow Keys/WASD to roll the block
Reach the red target hole to complete each level
Avoid falling off edges and fragile tiles!
Stand on blue split pads to split into two halves
tap or press Spacebar to switch between them
tips: Work from the corners — they constrain the board the most.
Plan two moves ahead before committing.
